name: Matching suite — line alignment vs live PO 4500000021

inputs.supplier_document: Supplier invoice INV-90010, ref PO 4500000021, GBP. Line 1: Material RM27 (Packaging Box) 50 PC at 25.00 per ea. Line 2: Material RM16 5 PC at 2.00 per ea.

expectedOutput.summary: Both supplier lines are aligned to PO items 10 (RM27) and 20 (RM16) by material at high confidence, carrying both the PO and supplier quantity and unit price; there are no unmatched supplier lines and no unmatched PO items.

evaluations.name: Supplier has an extra line not on the PO

inputs.supplier_document: Supplier invoice INV-90021, ref PO 4500000021, GBP. Line 1: Material RM27 50 PC at 25.00 per ea. Line 2: Material RM16 5 PC at 2.00 per ea. Line 3: Material RM99 10 PC at 4.00 per ea.

expectedOutput.summary: RM27 and RM16 align to PO items 10 and 20; the extra RM99 supplier line has no corresponding PO item and is reported as an unmatched supplier line.

evaluations.name: Supplier references only one of the two PO items

inputs.supplier_document: Supplier invoice INV-90022, ref PO 4500000021, GBP. Line 1: Material RM27 50 PC at 25.00 per ea.

expectedOutput.summary: The single supplier line aligns to PO item 10 (RM27); PO item 20 (RM16) is not referenced by the supplier document and is reported as an unmatched PO item.
